clue.text: Drunk's chosen to imbibe litres

definitions.note: read as 'Drunk is', the adjective for intoxicated

indicators.note: to imbibe is to take in, so the word for chosen swallows the litres

parts.note: chosen means picked

explanation.surface: A drunk has been selected to knock back litres of drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Pickled is informal slang for heavily intoxicated, as if preserved in alcohol.

clue.text: Bird with large beak having restricted breathing to a great extent

indicators.note: taking most but not all of the word, so its final letter is dropped

parts.note: puffing is laboured, short-winded breathing

explanation.surface: A big-beaked bird is struggling for breath much of the time.
explanation.definitionFit: The puffin is a seabird famous for its large, brightly striped bill.

clue.text: Have distinctive feature in mind — an ornate scroll

indicators.note: the distinctive feature is placed in the word for mind

parts.note: to mind is to care
a touch is a characteristic trait, as in a personal touch

explanation.surface: Someone is told to bear a distinctive flourish in mind when designing a decorative scroll.
explanation.definitionFit: A cartouche is a carved or drawn scroll-shaped ornament, also the oval frame round Egyptian royal names.

clue.text: Base of hill of less than average height

parts.note: short or low-lying things are low
a down is a rolling chalk hill, as in the South Downs of England

explanation.surface: The foot of a small hill is described.
explanation.definitionFit: Low-down as an adjective means mean or contemptible, a synonym of base in its moral sense.

clue.text: Decide to discourage working

parts.note: to deter is to discourage
a working is a mine or quarry being excavated

explanation.surface: Someone resolves to put people off their job.
explanation.definitionFit: To determine something is to settle or resolve it, the same as deciding.

clue.text: From obese state see a change to current health

indicators.note: the letter named is swapped for the one that follows it

parts.note: being obese is a state of fatness
the letter A as written
I is the physics symbol for electric current

explanation.surface: A doctor notes how an overweight patient's condition has turned around.
explanation.walkthrough: 'see' is a link; the A in FATNESS becomes I to give the word for health.
explanation.definitionFit: Fitness is physical good condition, a near synonym for health.

clue.text: Meeting minutes in favour of university going ahead

indicators.note: the university letter is put ahead of the minutes

parts.note: being for something is being in favour of it

explanation.surface: A meeting's minutes back the university's plans to proceed.
explanation.definitionFit: A forum is a gathering or assembly held for open discussion.

clue.text: Drink a lot of something to keep you warm in a cuppa

indicators.note: the shortened bedcover goes inside the drink

parts.note: a cuppa is British slang for a cup of tea

indicators.note: most of the word is used, losing its final letter

parts.note: a quilt is a warm bedcover

explanation.surface: Someone recommends drinking plenty of a warming thing in a cup of tea.
explanation.definitionFit: Tequila is a Mexican spirit distilled from agave, a type of drink.

clue.text: Antelope from Eastern province of Austria

parts.note: Austria's provinces are called Länder, singular Land

explanation.surface: An antelope is said to come from the eastern part of Austria.
explanation.definitionFit: The eland is a large African antelope with spiral horns.

clue.text: Son's leading in using bad language

indicators.note: the son letter comes in front

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for son; the 's reads as 'is'
to be in a garment is to be wearing it

explanation.surface: A boy is at the front, cursing.
explanation.definitionFit: Swearing is the use of profanity, which is what using bad language means.

clue.text: Dismiss restaurant worker that drops one stiff drink

parts.note: to fire is to dismiss from a job

indicators.note: the restaurant worker loses the letter for one

parts.note: a waiter serves in a restaurant
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Sack the waiter who spills a strong drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Firewater is a jocular term for strong spirits such as whisky.

clue.text: Decibels I got from quad bike can make one shudder

indicators.note: these letters are taken away from the vehicle's name

parts.note: dB is the abbreviation for decibels

explanation.surface: The noise level of a quad bike is enough to make a rider tremble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'can make one' is a link. Removing D, B and I from QUADBIKE leaves the five letters in order.
explanation.definitionFit: To quake is to tremble or shake, the same as shudder.

clue.text: I shot rook in this tree

indicators.note: shot means wrecked or ruined, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A hunter confesses to shooting a rook in this tree.
explanation.definitionFit: Iroko is a large West African hardwood tree whose timber resembles teak.

clue.text: Jogger needs to include a rest

indicators.note: the word for jogger must take the A inside it

parts.note: a memory jogger is a reminder

explanation.surface: A runner should build a rest into their routine.
explanation.definitionFit: The remainder is what is left over, the rest.

clue.text: Reward prisoner with television channel allocation

parts.note: con is slang for a convict
side is dated British slang for a TV channel, as in 'switch to the other side'
a ration is a fixed allocation

explanation.surface: An inmate gets a TV channel as a privilege.
explanation.definitionFit: A consideration is a payment or recompense given in return for something, a reward.

clue.text: Talkative former partner criticises wives heartily

parts.note: an ex is a former partner
to pan is to criticise harshly

indicators.note: taking the heart, the middle letters, of the word

explanation.surface: A chatty former spouse enthusiastically runs down wives.
explanation.definitionFit: Expansive describes someone open and communicative, talkative.

clue.text: Such reasoning invited upper-class Conservative's constituents to switch

indicators.note: the letters swap places into a new order

parts.note: U denotes upper-class
C is the abbreviation for Conservative

explanation.surface: Upper-class Tory voters are invited to change allegiance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'constituents' is a link. Inductive reasoning argues from particular cases to a general rule.
explanation.definitionFit: Inductive is a kind of reasoning, from specific examples to general conclusions.

clue.text: Convert a missile that's out of order

indicators.note: letters out of order are rearranged

explanation.surface: A faulty missile needs converting.
explanation.definitionFit: To Islamise is to convert people or a place to Islam.

clue.text: Like a gentle character we met pestered, unfortunately

indicators.note: things turning out badly suggests the letters are disturbed

explanation.surface: Someone mild-mannered whom we met was being harassed.
explanation.definitionFit: Being sweet-tempered means being good-natured, having a gentle disposition.

clue.text: To millions returning a high ball is fair game

parts.note: taken as written
M is the abbreviation for million

indicators.note: coming back, so the next words are read backwards

parts.note: a lob is a ball hit high in the air

explanation.surface: A ball hit high back to millions is seen as legitimate.
explanation.definitionFit: A tombola is a lottery drum game typical of a British fête or fair.

clue.text: I get less of Casanova, perhaps showing resistance for seconds

indicators.note: one letter stands in place of the other

parts.note: Casanova is the archetypal seducer
R is the symbol for electrical resistance

explanation.surface: A womaniser admits to waning interest, showing reluctance about second helpings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'showing' is a link. The definition speaks as the answer: a thing that diminishes says 'I get less of' something.
explanation.definitionFit: A reducer is something that lessens or diminishes, speaking in the first person.

clue.text: Bishop's morally good and intelligent

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
right means morally correct

explanation.surface: A churchman is described as virtuous and clever.
explanation.definitionFit: Bright means clever or quick-witted.

clue.text: Car flooring put together by functioning robot

parts.note: auto is short for automobile
a mat is a floor covering
on means working or operating

explanation.surface: A working robot builds car floor mats.
explanation.definitionFit: An automaton is a self-operating machine, a robot.

clue.text: Some matelots turned up for hire

indicators.note: in a down entry, turned up means read from bottom to top
only some of the word's letters are used

explanation.surface: A few sailors have been spotted showing up looking for work.
explanation.walkthrough: MATELOTS is British slang for sailors; a run inside it read upwards gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A property marked to let is available for rent, for hire.

clue.text: Quick to anger if not allowed to speak in court

indicators.note: the letters of 'if' are refused entry, so they come out

parts.note: to testify is to give evidence in court

explanation.surface: A witness becomes irritable when barred from giving evidence.
explanation.definitionFit: Testy means irritable and short-tempered.

clue.text: Scenery and dress mostly provided by men

indicators.note: most of the word, losing its last letter

parts.note: to deck is to dress or adorn
OR (other ranks) is the military abbreviation for ordinary soldiers

explanation.surface: Stage sets and costumes are largely supplied by the troops.
explanation.definitionFit: Décor is the scenery and furnishings of a stage set.

clue.text: A house up north is grand with one toilet outside

indicators.note: the one-and-toilet pair sits outside the letter for grand

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
loo is British slang for a toilet
G is slang for a grand, a thousand

explanation.surface: A northern house is impressive and has a single outdoor toilet.
explanation.definitionFit: An igloo is a dome-shaped Inuit dwelling built of snow in the Arctic.

clue.text: Using a needle gives sharp pain, including skin irritation

indicators.note: the word for a sharp pain takes the irritation inside it

parts.note: a sting is a sharp smarting pain
an itch is an irritation of the skin

explanation.surface: Sewing causes pricking pain and itching.
explanation.definitionFit: Stitching is sewing, which is done with a needle.

clue.text: Form of English that should be apparent at Dartmouth?

definitions.meaning: ... English is the accent of the Thames ... region around London

definitions.text: that should be apparent at Dartmouth?
definitions.meaning: Dartmouth stands at the mouth of the River Dart, where it widens to meet the sea

explanation.definitionFit: Estuary English is a named accent, and a river mouth such as the Dart's is a tidal inlet.

clue.text: Very serious promise

definitions.meaning: a pledge or token given in advance as a guarantee

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both an adjective for sincerity and a noun for a deposit or token of good faith.
